entities.summary: Kemah known historically as Ani-Kamakh, Gamakh, Kamacha or Kamachon is a town in Erzincan Province in the Eastern Anatolia region of Turkey. It is the seat of Kemah District. Its population is 2,929 (2022). The town is located almost in the centre of Erzincan Province.
